name: air-quality-monitor-coverage
title: Air Quality Monitor Coverage by State and District
description: How well each state and district is covered by India's continuous air quality monitoring network. For every unit: the number of CPCB monitors inside it, the number of monitored cities, and the share of its area lying within 50 km of any monitor. Nationally 36.2% of India's land area is within 50 km of a monitor, and 564 of 785 districts have none at all — the figure behind any claim that a district or state has an air quality reading.

sources.name: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring network

methodology: Monitor positions are buffered by 50 km on an equal-area projection (EPSG:6933) and intersected with each unit's geometry. Monitors just outside a border still count toward it, since they inform the air on both sides. Units are keyed by boundary feature id rather than LGD code, because two Jammu & Kashmir districts share the code 0. Rebuild with scripts/build-aq-coverage.py.
